title: danthonia glumosa
intro: Danthonia glumosa, commonly known as Poverty Grass, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Danthonia glumosa include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects.
